name: Currency Pair
description: The daily rates that convert one currency into the main currency of the books.

global.schema:
type CurrencyPairState {
  "The currency converted from, e.g. USD"
  base: String
  "The currency converted to: the main currency of the books, e.g. EUR"
  quote: String
  "One rate per day, the oldest first"
  rates: [RatePoint!]!
  lastFetchedAt: DateTime
}

type RatePoint {
  id: OID!
  "The day the rate applies to, at midnight UTC"
  date: Date!
  "How many quote one base is worth"
  rate: Float!
  "Where the rate comes from, e.g. ECB"
  source: String
  "Entered by hand: a fetched rate never overwrites it"
  manual: Boolean!
}

modules.name: pair
modules.description: Which two currencies the rates are for

operations.name: SET_PAIR

errors.name: InvalidPairCurrencyError
errors.description: A currency of the pair is not a three-letter ISO 4217 code

errors.name: SameCurrencyError
errors.description: Base and quote are the same currency

errors.name: PairLockedError
errors.description: The pair already holds rates for other currencies

operations.name: RECORD_RATES
operations.description: Record fetched rates, one per day; a day entered by hand is kept

errors.name: PairNotSetError
errors.description: The pair has no currencies yet

errors.name: InvalidRateError
errors.description: A rate is zero or negative

errors.name: DuplicateDateError
errors.description: The batch holds the same day twice

operations.name: SET_MANUAL_RATE
operations.description: Enter or correct the rate of one day by hand

errors.name: ManualPairNotSetError
errors.description: The pair has no currencies yet

errors.name: InvalidManualRateError
errors.description: The rate is zero or negative

operations.name: REMOVE_RATE
operations.description: Remove the rate of one day

errors.name: RateNotFoundError
errors.description: The pair holds no rate for that day
